calculation.expression: -return_20d / sqrt(mean(clip(return_1d, upper=0)^2,20))*sqrt(252) * (0.5 + 0.5*positive_day_breadth_20d), shifted one completed day
calculation.description: Ranks assets for contrarian rebound potential using 20-day loss, scaled by downside semideviation and mildly weighted by positive-day breadth. The one-day shift prevents look-ahead.

validation.regime_notes: 10-day IC remained positive in 2025-2026 (+0.16094), 2027-2029 (+0.01842), and 2030-2034 (+0.03301); uncertainty is material because the cross-section is 15 assets.
validation.method: Daily cross-sectional Spearman IC against forward close return; dates require at least 8 valid instruments; all 15 instruments were available on average.
